cross_check.pin_note: the parent names the instant it opened the store; three more map-bearing events landed while its run was in flight, so its counts are the store as of the later instant. This run is pinned there.
cross_check.status: informational, never gating: no threshold in this tool reads it
cross_check.why: the parent node and this tool read one column independently; equal counts mean they read it the same way

cutoff.as_of_is_mandatory: the live store grows continuously; an unpinned run is not reproducible and must not be published

label_salt_note: recorded on purpose: an 'after' run must hash the same label set to the same digest for the repeat concentrations to be comparable

load.why: a payload this tool cannot read is a count, never a silent drop; the map population is rows minus the three excluded_* lines

notes: Three denominators, never mixed: maps (2759), sel-carrying payloads (1262) and non-empty maps (1485). A payload without a sel block inspected an unknown number of candidates, not zero.
The persisted payload carries no cache key, so this census cannot split the no-cluster share by chat key versus node key; it reports the pooled share and the curtailed/uncurtailed split instead.
The no-cluster share is not flat in time: 0.461762 over the whole window against 0.662257 over the trailing 24h. Compare like windows, not one against the other.
Every one of the 1262 sel-carrying payloads is at the frozen width 7: on the wire, neither pool valve was charged on any server that wrote into this store.
Exclusions are not spread across the reason codes: lr accounts for 1156456 of 1283220.
privacy: aggregates only; every value passes usage_metric.check_privacy. No cluster label, ask_hint, query or node id reaches this artifact.

sel_epoch.why: sel was added after the column: this is the mechanical reason the map denominator and the sel denominator are different populations

curtailed.why: a curtailed map carries no clusters by construction; it is a different defect from a map whose pool yielded nothing

cluster_presence.denominator_note: persisted recall_map payloads in the window; NOT the sel population
cluster_presence.empty_pool_note: a map over an empty residual pool had nothing to describe; the rest had members and still delivered none

label_set_repeats.denominator_note: maps carrying at least one cluster; NOT the map count and NOT the sel population

digest.why_digest: cluster labels are forbidden output under check_privacy; the digest is a grouping key, published with its salt so a later run hashes the same label set to the same value

populations.why: three different denominators over one column: sel arrived after the column, so a map without sel is unmeasured, not zero. No ratio in this artifact mixes two of these populations.

selection_vector_width.denominator_note: sel-carrying payloads; NOT the map count
selection_vector_width.why: the vector is canonically trimmed to the frozen width when no gate fired, so width == frozen_width is the payload's own statement that neither env valve was charged on the server that wrote it

selector_admission.denominator_note: sum(sel.n) over sel-carrying payloads only; NOT the map count and NOT the number of payloads
selector_admission.reason_code_note: a code at zero excluded WITH zero payloads carrying it was never on the wire; a code at zero WITH payloads carrying it measured zero
